 radioButtons( 
    inputId = "distribution-type", 
    label = "Distribution Type", 
    choices = list(

      "Chi-squared" = 3 
    ) 
  )

numericInput( 
    "df", 
    "Degrees of freedom", 
    value = 10, 
    min = 1
)

numericInput( 
    "siglevel", 
    "Significance level", 
    value = 0.05, 
    min = 0,
    max=1,
    step=0.01
)

radioButtons(
    "tailness",
    "One tail or two tailed",
    choices = list(
        "one-tailed",
        "two-tailed"
    )
)

label = "Test statistic value:"
, value=0)

```{r}
#| context: server
#| 
distribution_functions <- list(
    "t" =  list(
        d = dt,
        q = qt
    )
)


dist_plot <- function (distribution, df, tailness, sig_level, test_statistic=0) {
    x_min <- -4
    x_max <- 4

    d_fun <- distribution_functions[[distribution]]$d
    q_fun <- distribution_functions[[distribution]]$q


    add_critical_regions <- function(ggplot_) {
        if(tailness == "one-tailed") {
        critical_val <- q_fun(1 - sig_level, df)
        return(ggplot_ + stat_function(aes(fill = "Critical region"),
                fun = d_fun,
                args = list(df = df), 
                xlim = c(critical_val,x_max),
                geom = "area", alpha = 0.5
                
            ) +                scale_fill_manual(
                    values = c("Critical region" = "red")
                ) +
             #geom_text(aes(x=critical_val, y=0, label=paste(critical_val)))
            geom_vline(aes(xintercept=critical_val, color="Critical Value"), linetype="dashed")
            + scale_color_manual(
                 values = c("Critical Value" = "red", "Test Statistic" = "blue")
                )

        )
        } else {
            upper_critical_val <- q_fun(1 - sig_level / 2, df)
            lower_critical_val <- q_fun(sig_level / 2, df)
            return(ggplot_ + stat_function(
                fun = d_fun,
                args = list(df = df), 
                xlim = c(upper_critical_val,x_max),
                geom = "area", fill = "red", alpha = 0.5
            ) +
            stat_function(
                fun = d_fun,
                args = list(df = df), 
                xlim = c(x_min,lower_critical_val),
                geom = "area",
                fill = "red",
                alpha = 0.5
            ) +
             geom_text(aes(x=upper_critical_val, y=0, label=paste(upper_critical_val)))
            +
             geom_text(aes(x=lower_critical_val, y=0, label=paste(lower_critical_val)))
            )
        }

    }
    ggplot_ <- ggplot() +
        xlim(x_min, x_max) +
        stat_function(fun=d_fun, args=list(df=df)) +
        labs(
            title = "t distribution"
        ) + geom_vline(
            aes(
                xintercept=test_statistic, color="Test Statistic"
            ),linetype='dashed'
            

        ) +
            stat_function(
                fun = d_fun,
                args = list(df = df), 
                xlim = c(test_statistic,x_max),
                geom = "area", fill = "blue", alpha = 0.7
            ) +
            geom_text(aes(x = test_statistic, y = 0, label = "hi"))
    add_critical_regions(ggplot_)

}

```

```{r}
#| context: server
#| 
dist_plot('t', df=10, tailness="one-tailed", 0.05)

dist_plot('t', df=10, tailness="two-tailed", 0.05)

```

```{r}
#| context: server

df <- reactive(input$df)
sig_level <- reactive(input$siglevel)
tailness <- reactive(input$tailness)
test_statistic <- reactive(input$test_statistic)
```
```{r}
#| include: FALSE
#| context: server
# Create a base plot with the desired x-axis range
output$debug <- renderText(df())
output$plot <- renderPlot(
    dist_plot('t', df(), tailness = tailness(), sig_level=sig_level(), test_statistic=test_statistic())

)
```
